Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Enable_tooltip: Persistent survivors originate from the map's real spawn towns, live whether or not you are looking,\nand remain where they were - or died -\nacross sessions. Turn off for a world without them.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Population: World population  (0 = size it from the map)
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Population_too:
How many living survivors the county maintains. At ZERO the county sizes itself from the map you actually installed:
one town's worth of
people for every spawn region the game offers, so installing a map mod adds people without touching this.
Only those near you carry live
bodies; the rest live dormant days (drift, meetings, lessons) at negligible cost.
Set a number to govern it yourself. An existing world
keeps the number it was created with and tops up to it through the refill clock. Zero is the shipped default and is NOT an empty world: the
county counts the spawn regions your installed maps actually have and sizes itself from them, which is about 216 people on a full Knox. Any
number you set here overrides that derivation.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Newcomers_tool:
How large the county may GROW to as people walk in from outside. At ZERO it follows World population three to one.
Once the helicopter has
stopped coming, the country beyond has clearly fallen and people are moving - roughly one a month takes to the road.
Whether they SETTLE
here is a different question: wars turn them away, mercy houses draw them in, winter thins the road.
Set equal to World population for a
closed county. A number BELOW the population closes it too, so the road stops entirely. Zero derives from World population rather than
meaning nobody arrives.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_MaterializeRad: A survivor whose position is within this range of you gets a live body in the world.\nEngine cells only exist near players; farther\nsurvivors simply wait where they are.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_HibernateRadiu:
A live survivor farther than this from you returns to a dormant record at their current position.
They are not gone - you left. Keep this
comfortably above the presence radius: it is the distance at which a body is put away, and the two crossing would make survivors materialise
and vanish on the same step.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RefillDays: Days the county waits after a death  (0 = replace at once)
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RefillDays_too:
Death is durable.
After this many in-game days, one new identity may originate at a spawn region - never at the site of the loss, never
near you. Zero does NOT mean nobody is replaced - it means the county refills the moment somebody dies. The wait is a hold on arrivals after
the newest death, so a larger number leaves the county thinner for longer after a bad night.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Desperation: Desperation threshold  (0.5 takes early - 1.0 never takes)
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Desperation_to:
The hunger or thirst level past which survival overrides property: claimed food and water get taken, and a told-off trespasser keeps
taking.
Below it, claims are respected and objections move people. This is the line where need overrides respecting somebody else's claim.
At 1.0 a survivor starves outside a stranger's door; at 0.5 they walk in early. Both halves of the county read it.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_TrustToCompany: Trust to keep company  (0.2 easy - 0.9 hard to win)
Mutual trust past this line turns two survivors into traveling company (and lets a trusted third join).\nLower for a chummier world; higher\nfor a lonelier one.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_ErrandRadius: Errand search radius  (tiles; doubled for a dormant day)
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_ErrandRadius_t:
How far a survivor looks for food, water, weapons, and ammunition when need sends them searching.
One floor up and down is always included
at a heavy detour penalty. A dormant day walks further than a loaded errand, so the unloaded half reads this doubled - at the default 12
that is the 24 tiles the dormant day used to hardcode.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Voice_tooltip: Terse spoken lines at meaningful moments - fleeing, warnings, thanks, grief.\nTurn off for silent survivors; every behavior still happens, unvoiced.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DayZero_toolti:
The county begins BEFORE the fall.
Nobody has learned fear yet, nobody has buried anyone, and the hard-won lessons that shape a survivor's
judgement have not been won.
Pair with low zombie counts and slow turning, and the county learns what it is becoming while you watch.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DormantRisk: Dormant risk multiplier  (1.0 = as dangerous as being there)
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DormantRisk_to:
How dangerous the county is for survivors outside the loaded world.
Rare by default and softened by hard-won lessons, company, and a
hardened past; word of a loss reaches their people a day or two later.
0 disables dormant deaths entirely. 1.0 means being away from you is
exactly as dangerous as being beside you. Below 1.0 the county is safer out of sight, which is a kinder world and a less honest one.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadTraffic: How busy the road is  (1 quiet - 12 constant)
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadTraffic_to:
How many people walk into the county together, roughly once a month, once the helicopter has stopped coming.
The month does not change -
this is how large a group the road brings when it brings anyone,
and whether they SETTLE here is still decided by what kind of county this
is.
At 1 the county gains about twelve people a year; at 12, about a hundred and forty.
Raise it if you want the map to fill within a
normal life, leave it low if you want the county to stay nearly what you found.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadPressure: Pressure from outside  (0 = none, 5 = an exodus)
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadPressure_t:
How hard the country beyond the county is pushing people onto the road.
The wait between arrivals shortens the longer the sky stays quiet,
because more of what is out there is walking by then.
At 0 the road never speeds up and arrivals stay a month apart, which is what a world
you do not touch gets.
Higher settings suit shorter days and longer runs. Who is on the road is not a fact about this county; whether any
of them stop here still is.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Telemetry: Write a record of the county
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Telemetry_tool:
Writes what the county learns to SAO_telemetry.jsonl in your Zomboid folder - one line per lesson learned, per death, and a daily
summary.
Changes no behaviour whatsoever: a survivor with this off lives exactly the life a survivor with it on lives.
It is an instrument
for understanding the simulation, not part of it. Turn it off if you do not want the file.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_HoldNeighbourP: Hold other survivor mods' prompts  (on = one county, one voice)

Other survivor mods push overhead notes and narrate people you cannot see
- 'a living voice drops to a whisper nearby' - and none of that is anything this county knows.
Two systems describing the same street to the same person, disagreeing, both speaking in the game's own voice.
With this on, those messages are HELD: counted, reported on the Ledger's top line, and handed back the moment you turn it off.
Their own mod options can silence the same thing with no help from us - this is for when you would rather not go looking.
